اعتمرتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَرْتُنَّ (iʕtamartunna) /iʕ.ta.mar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# اُعْتُمِرْتُنَّ (uʕtumirtunna) /uʕ.tu.mir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
